clue.text: Hand joint round and get a punch!

parts.note: a knuckle is a joint of the finger, part of the hand
a round is a sandwich made from two slices of bread

explanation.surface: An instruction to put your fist around something and throw a blow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' looks like a description of the fist's motion, but in British usage a round is one sandwich made from two whole slices of bread.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang phrase for a blow to the mouth delivered with the fist.

clue.text: North of India there's money? Just reported

indicators.note: reported means spoken out loud, so the sound of the words matters, not their spelling

parts.note: money is CASH and just (merely) is MERE

explanation.surface: A question about whether the north of India is rich, answered with mere hearsay.
explanation.definitionFit: The region lies at the northern tip of the Indian subcontinent.

clue.text: Drug addicts' unseen risk regularly overlooked

definitions.note: plural possessive in the clue; the answer is the plain plural noun

indicators.note: every other letter of the words unseen risk is passed over, keeping the first, third, fifth and so on

explanation.surface: A warning that the hidden danger to addicts is routinely ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for people who take illegal drugs habitually.

clue.text: Like more time initially for training in distance

indicators.note: training suggests putting the letters through a drill until they take a new shape
initially picks out the opening letter of the word time

explanation.surface: Advice that a runner should train for longer to cover more ground.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of LIKE, MORE and T (the first letter of 'time') gives the answer; 'for' and 'in' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A metric unit of length equal to a thousand metres.

clue.text: Terminated, accepting company's secret missive could be so

indicators.note: accepting means the word for terminated takes another piece inside it

parts.note: terminated means ended, finished

explanation.surface: A firm's confidential letter is cancelled after being received.
explanation.definitionFit: A hidden message is typically scrambled into cipher, which is what the adjective describes.

clue.text: On which one might drive and sleep outside during a stop?

indicators.note: during means the first and last letters go inside the phrase meaning a stop

parts.note: a halt is a stop

indicators.note: outside picks the first and last letters of the word sleep

explanation.surface: Asks what you might drive on, and whether one could nap at a lay-by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sleep outside' reads like camping out, but it means the first and last letters of sleep, S and P, which go during A HALT.
explanation.definitionFit: Road surfacing material made from bitumen and gravel, what cars run over.

clue.text: Model vegan collecting rummage

indicators.note: collecting means the words Model vegan hold the answer within their letters

explanation.surface: A vegan fashion model gathering items while searching through things.
explanation.definitionFit: To dig or search thoroughly through something, a synonym of rummage.

clue.text: Somehow noticing love cannot be recognised!

indicators.note: somehow says the letters of noticing are arranged in some other way than printed

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, the letter O

explanation.surface: A romantic exclaims that love goes unnoticed and unrecognised.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes someone in disguise, whose identity stays concealed from others.

clue.text: Execute boxer looking guilty

parts.note: to hang someone is to execute them on the gallows
a boxer is a breed of dog

explanation.surface: A grim order to put a prizefighter to death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxer' suggests a fighter, but it is the dog breed.
explanation.definitionFit: Hangdog means ashamed or sheepish in appearance.

clue.text: The girl has to ring back for some varnish

parts.note: she is the pronoun for a girl

indicators.note: back means the word for ring is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to ring is to call on the phone

explanation.surface: A girl must phone the shop again to order wood varnish.
explanation.definitionFit: A resin dissolved in alcohol, used as a wood finish or lacquer.

clue.text: Crossing place in order

indicators.note: order means the letters of place in are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Instructions about a place for something, put in order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' seems a phrase, but 'in' belongs to the letters being rearranged and 'order' alone is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A pelican crossing is a British pedestrian crossing with lights the walker controls.

clue.text: Press and TV etc, aimed to broadcast after church service

indicators.note: after means the rearranged letters come behind the service in the answer

parts.note: mass is the Catholic church service

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered, so the letters of aimed are rearranged

explanation.surface: Reporters aim to transmit coverage after a Sunday service.
explanation.definitionFit: Collective term for newspapers, television and radio that reach a wide public.

clue.text: Trimmed the border with diamonds

parts.note: an edge is a border
D is the card-game abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: A garment's border finished with diamonds.
explanation.definitionFit: Edged means bordered or trimmed, like a lawn or a sleeve.

clue.text: Turned right round — thanks to trendy odds

parts.note: a round shape is the letter O
ta is British informal for thanks

indicators.note: odds means the odd-numbered letters of trendy, the first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: Someone did a full turn, grateful to fashionable chances.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotated means spun on an axis.

clue.text: Cover for sailor girl finished off

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor

indicators.note: finished off means the end of the girl's name is cut away

parts.note: Pauline is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A sailor's girlfriend is ruined, needing a cover.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy waterproof canvas sheet used to protect things from rain.

clue.text: Experiencing pain after losing heart during tea

indicators.note: after means the pain comes behind the shortened tea in the answer
losing heart means the middle letter of tea is dropped

parts.note: a sting is a sharp pain

explanation.surface: Someone suffers a sharp pain, heartbroken over a cup of tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'during' does not signal an insertion here; it only loosely ties the trimmed tea to the pain that follows it, so read it as a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To taste something is to undergo or sample it, as in tasting success.

clue.text: Backing America to create a proven star

indicators.note: backing means the abbreviation for America is written in reverse

parts.note: US is the abbreviation for the United States of America

indicators.note: create means the letters a proven are made into something new

explanation.surface: American support makes a tried-and-tested celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: An exploding star that briefly becomes enormously bright.

clue.text: Note doctor setting trend

parts.note: MO is medical officer, a military doctor

indicators.note: setting means arranging, so the letters of trend are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A memo about a physician starting a fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical ornament: rapid alternation of a written tone with the one beside it.

clue.text: A small amount of old detectives rose in silence

indicators.note: in means the old detectives go inside the word for silence

parts.note: mum means silent, as in keep mum

indicators.note: rose means going upward, so in this down clue the detectives are read from bottom to top

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British police detectives

explanation.surface: Retired detectives quietly stood up, saying little.
explanation.definitionFit: A modicum is a tiny quantity, a little bit.

clue.text: Star gets a note to follow the ultimate in short wave

indicators.note: follow means the star, a and note come after that last letter
the ultimate in means the final letter of the word short

parts.note: the sun is a star
mi is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A celebrity singer gets a short tune after a brief burst of fame.
explanation.definitionFit: A huge sea surge caused by an earthquake or undersea upheaval.

clue.text: Endorsement for a couple of drinks

parts.note: to sup is to drink, and sup is also a mouthful
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a few drinks in return for backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Support is backing or approval, as given by an endorser.

clue.text: Imbibe more perhaps, seeing the boss

parts.note: to sup is to drink

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters of more could be ordered differently

explanation.surface: Drinking more might get you noticed by your manager.
explanation.definitionFit: A supremo is the person in overall charge, a head or chief.

clue.text: The ups and downs of the news?

definitions.text: The ups and downs of the news?

parts.words: The ups and downs of the news?
parts.note: rising and falling of the sea are tides, so whimsically a word for news is read as the movement of tides

explanation.definitionFit: An old word for news or reports, cryptically read as tide movements.

clue.text: Russian leader in silly sketch

indicators.note: in means the leader of Russian goes inside the word for silly

parts.note: daft means silly

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of Russian

explanation.surface: A satirical cartoon of the Russian president.
explanation.definitionFit: A draft is a rough preliminary version or outline, like a sketch.

clue.text: Letter of gratitude expressed supporting article

indicators.note: supporting means in this down clue the word of thanks sits below the article

parts.note: the is the definite article
ta is spoken thanks, British informal

explanation.surface: A thank-you letter backing up an article.
explanation.definitionFit: The eighth character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: The advantageous position of speed worker

parts.note: speed is amphetamine, and a stimulant drug is an upper
a hand is a worker, as on a farm

explanation.surface: Who holds the high ground: a fast labourer?
explanation.walkthrough: 'speed' suggests quickness, but here it is slang for amphetamine, a stimulant or upper.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the upper hand means having control or the edge in a situation.

clue.text: Copying recording, but missing the start

indicators.note: missing the start means the first letter of the word for recording is dropped

parts.note: taping is recording on tape

explanation.surface: A bootleg copy of a recording that lacks its opening.
explanation.definitionFit: Aping means mimicking or imitating.

clue.text: Crater left in gaming arcade

indicators.note: in means the letter for left goes inside the rearranged letters
gaming suggests playing around, so the letters of arcade are shuffled

explanation.surface: A hole left in the floor of an amusement arcade.
explanation.definitionFit: A large volcanic hollow formed when a volcano collapses.

clue.text: English proposal to show feelings!

definitions.note: plural in the clue; the answer is a singular noun that can be used collectively

parts.note: a motion is a proposal put forward for debate

explanation.surface: An English parliamentary proposal designed to stir sentiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Emotion means feeling, such as joy or anger.

clue.text: Fruit originally only found in Chinese mountains

indicators.note: found in means the first letter of only sits within the Chinese and mountains words

parts.note: Mandarin is the main language of China
ranges are chains of mountains

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of the word only

explanation.surface: A fruit said to grow only in the mountains of China.
explanation.definitionFit: Small loose-skinned citrus fruits, also called tangerines.
